rationale: The pain is real but episodic: Firebase server-side regressions that silently break production iOS apps are severe when they happen, but they are infrequent enough (this is a single HN post with 7 points referencing one GitHub issue) that the frequency score does not support a recurring subscription product. Willingness-to-pay evidence is entirely indirect—no competitor pricing, no 'is there a tool' requests, no paid workaround trail—and the build gates for operational_autonomy and buildability_with_ai both fail their minimum thresholds, meaning even a validated pain cannot be served by this factory without a technical co-builder. Killing now avoids a wasted validate cycle on a problem that structurally cannot be delivered autonomously.
